title: Fugaro workspace ls
description: The document `fugaro workspace ls --json` and `fugaro workspace show --json` print (docs/workspaces/spec.md §6): one workspace per row, read offline from this machine's own project configs. It is a named set of fields and not a marshalled localcfg.Config, which is the `config list` rule: a marshalled config would publish every key the file happens to carry, and the membership's pin is one of the keys it carries. The pin's assertion key is not a field here at all — a row says a membership is pinned, never what the member's key is. Members are only ever added within a version (D784), so a renamed or re-meant member is a new member under a new name and removing or retyping one bumps version. No object here is closed for that reason: additionalProperties is left true everywhere, because a consumer that refused a member this schema does not know would refuse a newer CLI's document, which the same version promises to keep readable.

workspaces.description: One row per workspace this machine knows, in name order: one its own project config declares here, one a project config here names, or both.

warnings.description: The project configs this read could not use, each naming the config and the loader's own refusal. They are in the document and not only on stderr, because a consumer would otherwise read a short listing as a complete one.

name.description: The workspace's name, which uses the project-name grammar (config.ProjectNameRE, F21).

owner.description: This machine holds the workspace's own project config, which is where the member table and the cap are written. It is what makes members readable: false means the members are on the workspace owner's machine and this document says nothing about them, rather than saying the workspace has none.

cap.description: The workspace's own spend ceiling, as this machine's config states it (D1300). Absent when there is none and when owner is false.

members.description: The member table of the workspace's own config here, in name order. [] is a workspace whose table declares no member yet, and null is a machine that does not hold that config at all. A consumer reads owner before it reads this.

memberships.description: The project configs on this machine that name the workspace, in name order: the member's own half, which is the key and the pin it carries.

problems.description: The half-done memberships this machine's own files show (W2's two-sided check, as far as this machine can make it): a member the workspace's table here declares whose config here names no workspace, and a config here that names the workspace whose table here does not declare it. Empty on a machine that holds no owner's config.

monthly_usd.description: US dollars a month, the same amount `fugaro workspace cap set --monthly` takes and the unit the config file writes. More than zero: a workspace with no cap leaves the block out rather than stating a zero.

project.description: The member's Fugaro project name, which is the key of the owner's table.

job_service_accounts.description: The member's job service accounts: the identities the workspace's service resolves a caller by (spec §5).

firebase_project.description: The member's Firebase project id, which the caller's token is issued under. The member's database URL is derived from it (finding 6) and is not a field here.

fp.description: The member's Fugaro project name, which the token's fp claim must be.

exchange_url.description: The member's exchange endpoint, where the workspace's signer mints a member-bound assertion for.

repos.description: The repositories the member contributes to the workspace, as owner/name. Empty for a member that contributes none.

project.description: The project config on this machine that names the workspace.

firebase_project.description: The pin's firebase_project: the workspace's Firebase project id, which the token's aud must be.

issuer.description: The pin's issuer, which is exactly https://securetoken.google.com/<firebase_project>.

service_account.description: The pin's service_account: the workspace service account this project's own fugaro update binds its read-only database grant to.
